message.reasoning_content: We need to list crimes based on the fact: The defendant Li set fire to a warehouse, causing economic loss of about 500,000 yuan. This is arson (故意毁坏财物罪) or arson causing large loss. In Chinese criminal law, arson is under "放火罪" (arson). Also could be "故意毁坏财物罪" but arson is specific. The fact: intentionally set fire to property causing economic loss. So the crime is "放火罪". Also possibly "非法占有财物罪"? No. So just "放火罪". Use format: [罪名]放火罪<eoa>. Ensure no extra.
